Technical Procedure

EquipmentGIS Circuit Breaker 220kv 
 AR13-PAEG
Introduction

This document outlines the 
 Minor Maintenance Procedures equipment inspection P1, which must be performed every five year 
 bases as indicated by Y5 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Anter Aly Bakr, 
accepted by general director: eng. Ibrahem M. Sayed El Ahl at Awlad Hmam 
220kv substation, and approved by eng. Abdel Rahem Abdel Rahem 
Abdel Rahem; EHV Network Head Sector, Delta zone.
Safety Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued,

The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc

Circuit 
breaker isolation and earthing is required

Change remet local control switch to local 
pasistion

Separote rebilling volve from volt a geand close 
shut off valve (371 / 372) fig 3

Vent the air from compressed air receiver via drain 
screw (314) or value (319) fig 3

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Adjustment work on the pressure switches must be carried out only by 
AEG-TFK staff

Before 
 starting any work on the pneumatic system:
 - Close shutoff valves 371, 372 from the supply line and secure against 
 unintentional opening, by removing the handle.
 - Switch off mini-circuit-breakers of the auxiliary voltage
 - Vent receiver 309 be means of valve 313. The flexible tube 317 on the 
 monitoring block 374 may be released only after the receiver has been 
 vented.

Check 
 adjustment and function of compressed air pressure switch 376F4 Fig. 2, 
 Adjustment work on the pressure switches must be carried out only by AEG-TFK 
 staff

items:
Check SF6 pressure on 
 manometer. (8 bar at 20 oC, rated pressure=7bar))

Check compressed air manometer 
 with control instrument.

Check air pressure on 
 manometer. 
 (20 bar)

Check SF6 manometer with 
 control instrument.

Check setting and 
 function of manometer contacts. 
 SF6 contact manometer, temperature-compensated 
 F1 density controllere
 K1: SF6-warning, 1st stage pe = 
 7.0 bar (p1)
 K2: SF6-operation, blocking 1 
 pe = 6.5 bar (p2)
 K3:
 SF6-operation, blocking 2 
 pe = 6.5 bar (p2)

Check SF6 moisture content 
 (desired level <20oC).

Check SF6 air content (desired 
 level <2%).

Check SF6 acid content (desired 
 level <5-10 ppmg ).

Check SF6 tightness at drive 
 shafts, (sniffing drill-hole)
Check for air and gas leaks. (audible noise or frequent refilling)

Before 
 starting any work on the pneumatic system:
 - Close shutoff valves 371, 372 from the supply line and secure against 
 unintentional opening, by removing the handle.
 - Switch off mini-circuit-breakers of the auxiliary voltage
 - Vent receiver 309 be means of valve 313. The flexible tube 317 on the 
 monitoring block 374 may be released only after the receiver has been 
 vented.
Drain compressed air receiver.

Check 
 adjustment and function of compressed air pressure switch 376F4 Fig. 2, 
 Adjustment work on the pressure switches must be carried out only by AEG-TFK 
 staff

Check tightness of screw and 
 pipe coupling.
 External diameter of pipe Permissible moment
 10 mm 7 Nm
 12 mm 10 Nm
 15 mm 14 Nm
 18 mm 17 Nm

Check refilling valve for function 
 and tightness. Refilling valve 373 (Y0) fig. 
 2

Check auxiliary switch
 S1 
 for function and burning of contacts. Figure 4

Check screw coupling of 
 electrical connections if necessary re-tighten.

Carry out test switching 
 operations, (before switching check SF6 pressure in the pole columns, and 
 the pressure of air in the compressed air receiver of the breaker):
 - 10 C-O-switching at one minute intervals.
 - Including 2 O-switching with the manual emergency valve.

Checking the pressure drop when 
 switching as the following steps:
 a
 - 
 Produce operating pressure. 10 bar
 b
 - 
 Separate refilling valve from voltage or close shutoff valves (371/372). 
 Figure 2
 c - Operate the circuit breaker electrically.
 d
 - 
 Read off values on manometer (375) five minutes later. 
 Figure 2
 At 20 OC the difference is about 0.6 bar 
 for opening, and about 0.3 bar for closing the breaker.
 e - Markedly increased pressure drops point to a fault in the pneumatic 
 system.

Check the mechanical On, OFF 
 position indicators.
